```plato
    //==
    // # IIndexable — fold / map family
    //
    // The general element-traversal primitives, usable on ANY IIndexable rather
    // than only on the concrete Array intrinsics. Each first materializes the
    // elements in index order via `MapRange(Count, i => At(i))` and then defers
    // to the corresponding Array intrinsic. Written with >= 2 parameters carrying
    // a type variable, so they clear the FunctionInstance single-type-var guard.

    // Folds the elements left to right from an initial accumulator: applies
    // f(acc, element) across the collection in index order. The general reduction
    // primitive behind sums, extents, and running aggregates on any indexable.
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fold_(higher-order_function))
    Reduce(xs: IIndexable<$T>, acc: $U, f: Function2<$U, $T, $U>): $U
        => MapRange(xs.Count, i => xs[i]).Reduce(acc, f);
```
